question: What will the first reported revenues after September 2026 be for the following companies? (Nvidia)

calls.reasoning: Resolves on Q3 FY27 actual revenue (quarter ending late Oct 2026, reported ~Nov 18-25). Guide is $108.0B ±2%. Nvidia has beaten the top of its range 12 straight quarters, with actuals 4.6-5.7% above the guide midpoint in the last four (Q3 FY26 57.0 vs 54; Q4 FY26 68.1 vs 65; Q1 FY27 81.6 vs 78; Q2 FY27 96.2 vs 91). That points to roughly $113-114B; a Motley Fool writer projects $113-114B and the analyst-consensus range was $104.9-116.3B (mean ~$109B). Upside: the Rubin ramp (~20% of Q3 data-center revenue) and +7-8% beats in FY25, so ~9% on going above $116B (a beat above 7.4%). Downside: supply limits (memory, power) through FY28 cap a big beat, and a miss below the $105.8B guide floor would be unprecedented in this regime. Live web tools failed this run (API errors); all evidence comes from yesterday's Nvidia research trace in the repo journal. Market check: no Polymarket or Kalshi contract on the revenue level, per that trace (only EPS-beat and word-mention contracts); not re-checked live.
